description: DAMs locations for Limpopo River Basin is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Harvard Dataverse. Dams alter natural water flow, create reservoirs, and provide benefits such as water supply, flood control, irrigation, and hydroelectric power. Dams data gethered using google maps,monographs and characteristics data - Massingir dam authority. Coverage: Botswana. The portal files it under the publisher Harvard Dataverse. Its tags are Earth and Environmental Sciences, DAMs, Topography, Earth observation, Limpopo. The repository dates the deposit 2024; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support dam, reservoir and flood defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
